caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a flat, slightly overhanging lid, predominantly painted in shades of green. The front and sides of the chest are decorated with symmetrical floral and leaf patterns in red, orange, and yellow hues, featuring two main circular floral motifs on the front panel and smaller heart-shaped designs along the borders and corners. Vertical black and orange elements resembling spindles or balusters divide the decorative sections. The chest sits upon a lower base section that is painted in a darker, weathered blue tone and contains three rectangular drawers, each with a keyhole. The chest has four short, bracket-shaped legs and its construction, including the hardware like hinges and drawer keyholes, is visible. The artwork is set against a plain, off-white background, and the artist's name "BETTY JEAN DAVIS" is inscribed in small capital letters in the lower left corner.
title: Pa. German Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
